concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) specifies a `quickstart.md` deliverable (Phase 1 output) but no task in tasks.md creates or populates this file. A task must be added to generate `quickstart.md` to satisfy the plan.
The plan calls for a `data-model.md` artifact (Phase 1 output) yet tasks.md contains no task that produces this document. Add a task to author `data-model.md` to achieve full plan coverage.

Tasks T131, T132, T133, and T134 (Scaling Law Analyzer, Adaptation vs. Optimization classifier, Complexity vs. Capability report, Bird vs. Frog mode toggle) are not referenced by any functional requirement, success criterion, or user story. They constitute orphan tasks and should be removed or linked to a concrete requirement.
